note: Kalhuiki 部族的商人,用 Sludge Juice 换 Jungle Key 等物品。翻译时注意他强调部族“护崽”的语气。

messages.zh: 欢迎来到我们村子,旅行者!

messages.raw: §fWe have much to offer and explore - but be careful.
messages.text: We have much to offer and explore - but be careful.
messages.zh: 这里有很多东西可看可换——不过要小心。

messages.raw: §fThe Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.
messages.text: The Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.
messages.zh: Kalhuiki 部族是友善的人,但护起自己人来毫不含糊。

messages.raw: §fDo not attack our young, else we will put you down.
messages.text: Do not attack our young, else we will put you down.
messages.zh: 别攻击我们的孩子,否则我们不会放过你。

messages.raw: §fI'm supposed to collect some food for the village, the Kalhuiki people have been through a tough time recently.
messages.text: I'm supposed to collect some food for the village, the Kalhuiki people have been through a tough time recently.
messages.zh: 我得给村里收集些食物,Kalhuiki 人最近日子很不好过。

messages.raw: §fPerfect! I'll share the good news with my village!
messages.text: Perfect! I'll share the good news with my village!
messages.zh: 太好了! 我这就把好消息带回村里!

messages.raw: §fI guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.
messages.text: I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.
messages.zh: 看来我只能空着手回去了。
